ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota welfare system to identify potential corruption and fraud
questions: How did $18 billion in welfare funds go missing?
Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption in the Minnesota welfare system. By following the money, we may be able to identify key players and patterns of fraud.
